messages:
Sasha (HW Partnerships): Quick sync — NexusEdge asked for a publishable perf/W + throughput artifact. We need a reproducible protocol they can run in their lab.
Evan (Perf Eng): OK. Core decisions: external power meter model + placement, fan control policy, stabilization period, and exact kernel/driver versions.
Priya (ML Applied): Add: prompt tokenization, model checkpoint hash, and deterministic RNG seed. We'll use a 500-sample subset from our eval set.
Rita (Solutions): NexusEdge legal requires a 7-day review window and raw telemetry before any joint announcement. They also want a short partner quote template.
bench-bot: created folder: https://redwood.example/s/nexus-bench and template runbook uploaded.
Sasha (HW Partnerships): My draft protocol: 2-hr thermal soak @ target power, 3 steady-state runs of 10 minutes each, report median throughput and median perf/W. Use external meter reading averaged over steady window.
Evan (Perf Eng): For kernels, let's freeze toolchain: gcc 12.3, glibc 2.35, kernel 6.1. Pin CUDA 12.1 / ROCm X.Y as applicable. Document `-O3 -march=native` flags for CPU helpers.
Priya (ML Applied): Model variant: llama2-7b q4 and q8 both (if hardware supports q8) for curve. Prompts: max_new_tokens=256, temp=0.0, seed=42. Batch shapes: 1/16/64. Warmup: 10 short prefixes of 64 tokens before measurement.
NexusEdge PM: FYI we'll book lab time Wednesday afternoon. Want the runnable script and exact steps by Tuesday EOD.
Evan (Perf Eng): I'll produce `run_nexus_bench.sh` and a small verifier that checks telemetry schema (JSONL). Example expected line: `{"ts":"2026-03-10T18:04:00Z","sample":"s001","tokens":128,"p50":10.2,"p90":14.6,"power_w":295.3,"gpu_temp_c":68.0,"kernel":"6.1.0","model":"llama2-7b-q4"}`
Rita (Solutions): Announcement gating checklist (short): raw telemetry, runbook + scripts, partner-signed artifact consent, internal perf review doc, marketing preview. I'll draft and share.
Sasha (HW Partnerships): Who owns ingest/verifier? If NexusEdge runs, they should upload results to shared folder and we run verifier.
Evan (Perf Eng): Agreed. I'll write the verifier and a reproducibility checklist. Also include a small diff tool to compare outputs vs our hosted run to ensure no quant regression.
Priya (ML Applied): We'll run the same prompts on our hosted instance once we get their results. Capture commit hashes for model code and quant lib.
bench-bot: ticket created P-4412 "NexusEdge joint perf bench". Link: https://pm.redwood.example/t/P-4412
Sasha (HW Partnerships): Timeline: Tue EOD handoff, Wed partner run, Thu ingest + verify, Fri sign-off draft. Add a buffer day if kernel retune needed.
NexusEdge PM: Sounds good. We'll confirm lab slot and share BMC access method.
Rita (Solutions): I'll include legal checklist and partner quote template in the shared folder.
Evan (Perf Eng): Note: record both AC draw and DC from board if possible. Annotate any differences.
Priya (ML Applied): Also record model output hashes for each sample so we can prove functional equivalence.
Sasha (HW Partnerships): Great. Action items: Evan -> run script + verifier; Priya -> prompt set + hosted sanity run; Rita -> gating doc + legal template; bench-bot -> create folder and ticket (done). I'll email NexusEdge with handoff plan.
Evan (Perf Eng): On it.
Priya (ML Applied): On it.
Rita (Solutions): On it.
Sasha (HW Partnerships): Closing for now. Will post the runbook link here when ready. :white_check_mark:
